verdict.rationale: The docs show several data products (account owner verification, balances, transactions and aggregation) that all read from a 'connected account' linked via Connect. This implies one link can serve several products, but no source states that a single Connect session unlocks all of them without separate connection flows per product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one Connect session covers auth/ACH, balance, transactions and identity together; any statement that product-specific re-linking is unnecessary; hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, one link session can power multiple data products — auth, balances, transactions, identity — without forcing the user through separate connection flows per product

citations.quote: link them to at least one account via Connect
Retrieves account ownership details (name, address, email and phone - where available) from a connected account at a financial institution.

The Account Balance service provides real-time or cached bank account balance information from your customer's Financial Institution (FI).
